r=Path(__file__).parent
model=Path.home()/'.cache/huggingface/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3-0.6B-GGUF/snapshots/23749fefcc72300e3a2ad315e1317431b06b590a/Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf'
prompt=r.parent/'llmx-f32-controls/prompt.txt'
out=r/'forced-long';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
for arm in ['base','float-control','int16']:
    print('START '+arm,flush=True)
    exe=r/(arm+'-long.exe')
    p=subprocess.run([str(exe),str(model),str(prompt),str(out/arm),str(r/'hf-continuation.txt')],capture_output=True,timeout=180)
    (out/(arm+'.stdout')).write_bytes(p.stdout);(out/(arm+'.stderr')).write_bytes(p.stderr);p.check_returncode()
    print('END '+arm,flush=True)
prefixes={name:out/name for name in ['base','float-control','int16']}
prefixes['hf']=r.parent/'llmx-attention-long/hf'
suffixes=['-logits.f32']+[f'-step-{i:02d}.f32' for i in range(32)]
pairs=[('base','hf'),('float-control','hf'),('int16','hf'),('int16','base'),('float-control','base'),('int16','float-control')]
results={}
for a,b in pairs:
    largest=0;squared=0;count=0;top1=0
    for suffix in suffixes:
        x=(Path(str(prefixes[a])+suffix)).read_bytes();y=(Path(str(prefixes[b])+suffix)).read_bytes()
        assert len(x)==len(y)==151936*4
        xx=struct.unpack('<151936f',x);yy=struct.unpack('<151936f',y)
        assert all(math.isfinite(v) for v in xx) and all(math.isfinite(v) for v in yy)
        top1+=max(range(len(xx)),key=xx.__getitem__)==max(range(len(yy)),key=yy.__getitem__)
        for u,v in zip(xx,yy):
            delta=abs(u-v);largest=max(largest,delta);squared+=delta*delta;count+=1
    results[a+'_vs_'+b]=dict(values=count,max_abs_error=largest,rms_error=math.sqrt(squared/count),top1_equal=top1,vectors=len(suffixes))
    print(a,b,results[a+'_vs_'+b],flush=True)
results['provenance']={name:hashlib.sha256(b''.join(Path(str(prefix)+s).read_bytes() for s in suffixes)).hexdigest() for name,prefix in prefixes.items()}
results['scope']='1943 prompt tokens plus 32 forced HF continuation tokens; all comparisons share inputs. Full-vector measurement, not a full-corpus or maximum-context quality proof.'
(out/'comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
